assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The syncope and near-syncope is coded R55
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation
The unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded I48.91
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The appeal references the ordering note
The appeal requests reconsideration of the precertification determination on the basis of documented medical necessity
